opts.vi: đeo vòng cổ tay nối đất và để linh kiện trong bao bì chống tĩnh điện cho tới khi dùng
opts.en: wear a grounded wrist strap and keep parts in their anti-static packaging until needed

opts.en: work next to high-voltage fluorescent lights

explain.en: Also: heel straps, static-dissipative floor and bench mats, avoiding very dry places, ground jacks, grounded test equipment, low-voltage soldering, anti-static IC tools, avoiding nearby high-voltage sources.
